page.title: Staff workspace.
page.body: Manage your public staff profile, guild operations, blacklist appeals, team applications and bot health from one place — with live bot-wide analytics for planning the next rollout.
logs.title: Live logs
logs.body: The bot's console as it is written, colour for colour. The buffer holds this process's output since it started — or since the last in-place update — and the level below filters only this page.
logs.hidePymongoHint: Keeps MongoDB's debug output out of the console.
logs.hideUrllib3Hint: Keeps urllib3's connection and retry debug output out of the console.
logs.hideWavelinkHint: Keeps wavelink's player and node debug output out of the console.
logs.empty: Nothing has been logged at this level yet.
logs.filteredEmpty: No lines match the current filters.
logs.error: The live log could not be read.
logs.unavailable: This process is not writing to the log buffer yet.
logs.truncated: Older lines have rolled out of the buffer.
